member.name: T:Khazar.WebAPI.ExceptionHandling.GlobalExceptionHandler
member.summary: Translates application and domain exceptions into RFC 7807 ProblemDetails responses, so controllers stay free of try-catch blocks. Unexpected exceptions become a generic 500: the client receives only a trace id it can quote to support, while the full exception is logged with the same trace id for correlation. The response is always JSON, even when the client did not ask for it in the Accept header.
